edge closer to victory: With two minutes left, the home team scored again and began to edge closer to victory.
比賽剩下兩分鐘時，主隊再度得分，開始逐漸逼近勝利。
edge out a rival: In the final race, she managed to edge out a rival by just 0.1 seconds and won the gold medal.
在決賽中，她以僅僅0.1秒之差險勝對手，贏得金牌。
prices edged up: Because of the typhoon, vegetable prices edged up slightly last week, which worried many families.
由於颱風的關係，上週菜價微漲，讓許多家庭感到擔心。
edge forward: The line was so long that we could only edge forward a few steps every ten minutes.
隊伍排得太長，我們每十分鐘只能慢慢前進幾步。
on edge: Waiting for her exam results all morning, Amy was on edge and couldn't eat anything.
整個早上都在等考試成績，艾咪緊張不安，什麼都吃不下。
edit a film: It usually takes months to edit a film, because the director must choose the best shots from hours of video.
剪輯影片通常要花好幾個月，因為導演必須從數小時的影像中挑出最好的鏡頭。
edit out a scene: The director decided to edit out a scene that was too violent for young viewers.
導演決定剪掉一幕對年輕觀眾來說太暴力的畫面。
edit one's words: When you talk to your boss, you should edit your words carefully so that you don't sound rude.
跟老闆說話時，你應該仔細斟酌用語，才不會聽起來很沒禮貌。
edit a newspaper: Her job is to edit a newspaper: she corrects spelling mistakes and shortens long articles every day.
她的工作是編輯報紙：她每天修正拼字錯誤並把過長的文章縮短。
elaborate on the plan: The manager asked Tom to elaborate on the plan because nobody understood how it would save money.
經理請湯姆詳述計畫，因為沒有人了解它要如何省錢。
an elaborate scheme: The thieves came up with an elaborate scheme that took months to prepare and involved ten people.
竊賊想出一個精心設計的計謀，花了好幾個月準備，牽涉到十個人。
elaborate a theory: In his new book, the scientist tries to elaborate a theory about why some people learn languages faster.
在他的新書中，這位科學家試圖闡述一個理論，說明為什麼有些人學語言比較快。
elbow one's way through: The concert was so crowded that he had to elbow his way through the crowd to reach the stage.
演唱會非常擁擠，他必須用手肘擠過人群才能到達舞台前。
elbow someone aside: A rude man tried to elbow someone aside so that he could get on the crowded bus first.
一個粗魯的男子想把某人推開，好讓自己先擠上擁擠的公車。
elbow room: The new apartment is small, but there is enough elbow room for a desk and a bookshelf.
新公寓雖然小，但有足夠的活動空間可以放一張書桌和一個書架。
elect a president: Every four years, citizens in Taiwan go to vote to elect a president who will lead the country.
每四年，台灣的公民就會去投票選總統，由他來領導國家。
elect to stay: Although her friends went home early, Lisa elected to stay and help clean up after the party.
雖然她的朋友們早早回家了，麗莎選擇留下來，在派對後幫忙打掃。
be elected chairman: After all the votes were counted, Mr. Lin was elected chairman of the club with more than half of the votes.
所有選票開完後，林先生以過半數的票當選社團主席。
eliminate poverty: The government hopes to eliminate poverty by creating more jobs and offering free education.
政府希望透過創造更多工作機會和提供免費教育來消除貧窮。
eliminate errors: Check your essay twice to eliminate errors before you hand it in to the teacher.
把作文交給老師之前，要檢查兩遍以消除錯誤。
be eliminated in the first round: Our team practiced very hard, but sadly we were eliminated in the first round of the tournament.
我們的隊伍練習得非常努力，但很遺憾我們在錦標賽首輪就遭到淘汰。
eliminate a suspect: The police were able to eliminate a suspect because he was in another city when the crime happened.
警方得以排除一名嫌疑人的嫌疑，因為案發時他人在另一個城市。
embrace change: Companies that embrace change and try new ideas are more likely to survive in a fast-moving world.
擁抱改變並嘗試新點子的公司，在快速變動的世界中比較有可能生存下來。
embrace new technology: My grandmother was slow at first, but she finally learned to embrace new technology and now video-chats with us every week.
我奶奶一開始學得很慢，但她最後學會接納新科技，現在每週都和我們視訊聊天。
embrace a religion: After traveling in India for a year, he decided to embrace a religion that teaches peace and kindness.
在印度旅行一年後，他決定皈依一個教導和平與仁慈的宗教。
embrace diversity: Our school tries to embrace diversity by welcoming students from many different countries and cultures.
我們學校努力擁抱多元，歡迎來自許多不同國家和文化的學生。
embrace an opportunity: She decided to embrace an opportunity to study in Japan, even though she would miss her family.
她決定把握到日本留學的機會，即使她會想念家人。
emerge as a leader: From a group of shy first-year students, Kevin emerged as a leader during the class trip.
在一群害羞的一年級學生中，凱文在班級旅行期間嶄露頭角，成為領袖。
emerge from recession: The economy finally began to emerge from recession, and many companies started hiring again.
經濟終於開始走出衰退，許多公司又開始招募員工。
the truth emerged: Weeks later, the truth emerged: the missing money had been taken by the manager himself.
幾週後真相浮現：失蹤的錢是經理自己拿走的。
a pattern emerges: When you study the sales data from the past ten years, a pattern emerges: sales always rise in December.
當你研究過去十年的銷售數據時，一個模式浮現了：銷售額總是在十二月上升。
emerging markets: Many companies are investing in emerging markets like India and Vietnam, where the economies are growing quickly.
許多公司正在投資印度和越南等新興市場，這些地方的經濟成長快速。
